# Contributing

The contribution policy of the Firestarter project is on the wiki:
[Contributing](https://github.com/henols/firestarter/wiki/Contributing).

That page tells you where to report a problem and where to open a pull request. It also tells you
how to coordinate a change that touches more than one repository.
